title: Common definitions
description: The definitions that the parts of a module share: the format version, IDs and versions, languages, the license, age categories, school grades, subjects, the paths of media files and pictures, texts, the parts of a text that the learner reads, a canvas, and a rectangle of the handwriting sheet.

module_format_version.description: A version of the module format, MAJOR.MINOR, written as a string: "0.1".

module_id.description: The ID of a module, <publisher>/<name>, each a name in kebab-case that begins with a letter: novatrail/olympiad-math. The publisher owns the namespace its modules' names are in. Neither name is one that Windows reserves for a device, such as con or lpt1, since an ID may name a folder.

module_version.description: The version of a module in Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, X.Y.Z, with no pre-release and no build metadata, written as a string: "1.2.0".

local_id.description: The local ID of a skill, task, trap, technique or lesson: unique among the module's entries of its kind, in kebab-case, beginning with a letter, at most 64 characters, and not a name that Windows reserves for a device, since a local ID may name a file: counting-gaps.

skill_id.description: The local ID of a skill.

task_id.description: The local ID of a task.

trap_id.description: The local ID of a trap.

technique_id.description: The local ID of a technique.

lesson_id.description: The local ID of a lesson.

band_id.description: The ID of a band of the module's difficulty scale, of the form of a local ID and unique among its bands. A band is no entry of the module, and no full ID names it.

language_tag.description: A language as a BCP 47 tag (RFC 5646) of a language subtag, an optional script and an optional region, each in the letter case of the registry: en, zh-Hans, pt-BR, es-419. Written in quotes when it is no, which YAML 1.1 reads as false.

license.description: A license as an identifier of the SPDX License List, such as Apache-2.0 or CC-BY-SA-4.0: letters, digits, . and -.

age_category.description: An age category: under 13; from 13 to the age of digital consent in the learner's country; from that age to 18; 18 and over.

grade.description: A school grade, from 1 to 12, as the module's author counts them: the platform does not map the grades of one country to another's.

subject.description: The code of a subject: what a module teaches.

media_path.description: The path of a media file from the module's media/ folder: names in kebab-case that begin with a letter, joined by /, and the extension of the file's format — .png, .jpg, .webp or .mp3. No name is one that Windows reserves for a device. pictures/ladder.png.

picture_path.description: The path of a picture from the module's media/ folder: a media path whose extension is .png, .jpg or .webp.

text.description: A text of the module for people to read, in its explanation language. Not empty.

picture.description: A picture, by its path from media/.

alt.description: What the picture shows, in words: a screen reader reads it, and it stands in the picture's place until the picture comes. Empty for a picture that only decorates.

width.description: The width the picture is shown at, in CSS px; narrower when the text it stands in is.

height.description: The height the picture is shown at, in CSS px, in proportion to its width.

statement_part.description: A part of a text that the learner reads — a statement, a solution or an explanation: a paragraph, or a picture with what it shows and its size.

kind.description: The canvas kind: a handwriting sheet, a free sheet of 1000 × 1400 units; or a workbook, lines of items with boxes for the answers.

grid.description: The grid of a handwriting sheet: squares, lines or dots; squares unless given.

grid_step.description: The step of the grid of a handwriting sheet, in its units: 50 unless given.

canvas.description: A canvas: its kind, and the grid of a handwriting sheet.

left.description: How far the rectangle begins from the left edge of the sheet, in its units.

top.description: How far the rectangle begins from the top edge of the sheet, in its units.

width.description: The width of the rectangle, in units of the sheet.

height.description: The height of the rectangle, in units of the sheet.

sheet_rectangle.description: A rectangle of the handwriting sheet, in its units of 1000 × 1400 from the top left corner.
